# ADR-3016: A02: Cleartext credential log line for channel 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Secrets in logs propagate through aggregators.

## Decision

Services SHALL NOT emit a cleartext credential log line for channel 4 (A02-4).

## Consequences

Redaction filters cover tokens and passwords.
